outputEncoding: Each record.outputsRef resolves to its exact normalized outputs array in outputSets. Keys are SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and comma/colon separators. Identical arrays are stored once; all measured values and original record file digests remain per trial.
interpretation: All 12 trials, warmups included, computed ten new matches in fresh processes and empty output directories. All slots, simulation/result hashes and compressed chunk/checkpoint checksums agree. No result reuse, missing spans or dropped records.

Measured wall medians are 40938.421ms baseline and 41666.231ms candidate (+1.78%). Keep all five paired differences; this bounded-queue implementation does not establish a speedup in this two-Worker pilot.

Five actual official-20-v2 battlefields and both placements are represented, but only guardian/fire-mage and one seed. This is a local partial pilot, not full 20/7600 coverage or a GitHub runner scalability comparison.

The candidate holds a single admission credit through calculation and durable publication. Its whole admitted window is at most two single-match units/40MiB, including any inner producer prefetch. Tight work capacity reduces it to one. With this first unit size, 3/4 Workers still have at most two admitted matches.

CPU-heavy validation remains on its current thread; async publication does not establish parallel CPU verification. Verification placement, pool lifetime and WAL policy comparisons remain outstanding.

Each variant still performs 30 complete replay validations and 10 TRUNCATE checkpoints per trial. The small observed checkpoint time is not a threshold-policy or crash-safety comparison; WAL policy is unchanged.

Process CPU includes Worker CPU. Inclusive stages overlap and must not be added to wall or CPU. Process high-water RSS includes setup; directory sizes are post-run measurements, not peaks. Capacity samples are sampled maxima, not complete continuous disk accounting.

The save.read failure counters retain expected missing-file probes on fresh directories; command/partition completion and receipt checks determine trial success. No failed or interrupted trial is silently dropped.

Process startup, plan/input preparation, post-run output comparisons, GitHub setup/artifacts, R2 and Pages are excluded. No 270/300-second end-to-end acceptance, production improvement, or 16/32-runner go decision follows from this pilot.
The candidate SHA names the exact clean runtime code commit before this evidence file. It is not restamped to the later documentation commit.

The superseded initial pilot is retained separately: eight completed observations, the interrupted ninth trial with no completed receipt/output, and three unattempted trials. Its incorrect admission/cancellation behavior was fixed before registering this complete pilot; it is excluded from the accepted comparison.

reproduction.instructions: Check out plan.baseline and plan.candidate separately, install each frozen pinned toolchain, extract the exact driver/runner strings into a scratch directory, and adapt only runner workspace paths. Retain the registered order and 120-second timeout. Run node --import tsx DRIVER REPOSITORY OUTPUT.json from each apps/cli directory. Never mutate a measured checkout or run tests/other simulations concurrently. Raw receipts retain the actual original commands and directories.
